title: AZ-900 · Describe the benefits of using cloud services · Module assessment

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Which statement best describes High availability?

options.text: Designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions
The ability to estimate and forecast cloud spending
A model in which more platform patching and maintenance are handled by the provider
The ability to anticipate the resources needed to deliver a consistent user experience

questions.explanation: High availability is designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Service-level agreement (SLA) refer to?

options.text: Removing resource instances when demand falls
The ability of cloud-scale infrastructure and security services to help withstand distributed denial-of-service attacks
Reducing capacity when demand decreases instead of keeping resources overprovisioned
A service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee

questions.explanation: Service-level agreement (SLA) is a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Which description correctly matches Scalability?

options.text: Distributing traffic so that one resource is not overloaded while others are underused
Designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions
The ability to adjust resources to meet changes in demand
Reducing resource capacity when demand falls so you avoid paying for unnecessary capacity

questions.explanation: Scalability is the ability to adjust resources to meet changes in demand.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Vertical scaling up?

options.text: Notifications generated when configured metrics or conditions are reached
Increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine
The potential for large cloud providers to use infrastructure more efficiently than many isolated environments
Using standards, policies, templates, and auditing to keep deployments aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements

questions.explanation: Vertical scaling up is increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: What is the primary meaning of Vertical scaling down in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: A scripting and command-line option for automating cloud management tasks
A defined set of standards against which cloud resources can be evaluated
Observing resource health and responding to failures
Reducing the capabilities of a resource, such as decreasing CPU or RAM

questions.explanation: Vertical scaling down is reducing the capabilities of a resource, such as decreasing CPU or RAM.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: High availability: increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine.
Service-level agreement (SLA): a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.
Service-level agreement (SLA): removing resource instances when demand falls.
Scalability: using distributed regions so a failure in one location does not necessarily stop the whole solution.
High availability: designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: High availability — designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions; and Service-level agreement (SLA) — a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: Scalability: the ability to adjust resources to meet changes in demand.
Vertical scaling up: the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue functioning.
Vertical scaling up: increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine.
Vertical scaling up: the ability to anticipate the resources needed to deliver a consistent user experience.
Scalability: adding more resource instances, such as additional virtual machines or containers.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Scalability — the ability to adjust resources to meet changes in demand; and Vertical scaling up — increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Select TWO correct statements about the material in this Microsoft Learn unit.

options.text: Vertical scaling down: the ability to estimate and forecast cloud spending.
Horizontal scaling out: the ability to anticipate the resources needed to deliver a consistent user experience.
Horizontal scaling out: adding more resource instances, such as additional virtual machines or containers.
Vertical scaling down: reducing resource capacity when demand falls so you avoid paying for unnecessary capacity.
Vertical scaling down: reducing the capabilities of a resource, such as decreasing CPU or RAM.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Vertical scaling down — reducing the capabilities of a resource, such as decreasing CPU or RAM; and Horizontal scaling out — adding more resource instances, such as additional virtual machines or containers.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Which TWO statements are consistent with the unit content?

options.text: Consumption-aware scaling: reducing resource capacity when demand falls so you avoid paying for unnecessary capacity.
Consumption-aware scaling: automatically adding or removing resources as demand changes.
Horizontal scaling out: automatically adding or removing resources as demand changes.
Horizontal scaling in: using distributed regions so a failure in one location does not necessarily stop the whole solution.
Horizontal scaling in: removing resource instances when demand falls.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Horizontal scaling in — removing resource instances when demand falls; and Consumption-aware scaling — reducing resource capacity when demand falls so you avoid paying for unnecessary capacity.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.question: Choose the TWO accurate statements.

options.text: Decentralized cloud design: using distributed regions so a failure in one location does not necessarily stop the whole solution.
Reliability: the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue functioning.
Reliability: the ability to estimate and forecast cloud spending.
Decentralized cloud design: a tool that can estimate potential Azure spending before resources are deployed.
Horizontal scaling in: distributing traffic so that one resource is not overloaded while others are underused.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Reliability — the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue functioning; and Decentralized cloud design — using distributed regions so a failure in one location does not necessarily stop the whole solution.
